Latest periods: FCT FY26 (22 Oct 2026); Suntec 3Q26 (22 Oct 2026); OUE 3Q26 (21 Oct 2026); FLCT 3QFY26 business update (30 Jul 2026; FY26 results due early Nov); PLife 1H26 (4 Aug 2026; 3Q due 3 Nov); Starhill FY25/26 (29 Jul 2026; 1Q due 29 Oct); Lendlease REIT FY26 (3 Aug 2026; 1Q due 30 Oct); ESR-REIT 1H26 (28 Jul 2026; 3Q not yet out).
